## Loading packages 

```{r}
#| title: load-packages
#| message: False

library(tidyverse)
library(openintro)
library(infer)

```

```{r}
#| title: the-data


data('yrbss', package='openintro')

?yrbss

glimpse(yrbss)
```

## Exercise 1 

There are a total of 13,583 cases in this dataset and each is a high schooler in 9th through 12th grade

```{r}
#| title: exploration 

summary(yrbss$weight)
```

## Exercise 2 

We are missing a total of 1004 entries

```{r}
#| title: plot

yrbss <- yrbss %>% 
  mutate(physical_3plus = ifelse(yrbss$physically_active_7d > 2, "yes", "no"))
```

## Exercise 3 

```{r}
#| title: box-plot

ggplot(yrbss, aes(x = physical_3plus, y = weight)) +
  geom_boxplot()

```

The boxplot shows that the weights of the more active highschool kids is ever so slightly higher than the non-active ones. However, the data is very close.

```{r}
#| title: data-manip

yrbss %>%
  group_by(physical_3plus) %>%
  summarise(mean_weight = mean(weight, na.rm = TRUE))

```

## Exercise 4

The conditions for inference should be satisfied. The data comes from a simple random source, they should all be independent from one another and the data source is sufficiently large to create a normal distribution when sampling means.

## Exercise 5 

$H_0: \text{Being active does not affect weight} \\ H_a: \text{Being active does affect weight}$

```{r}
#| title: hypothesis


obs_diff <- yrbss %>%
  drop_na(physical_3plus) %>%
  specify(weight ~ physical_3plus) %>%
  calculate(stat = "diff in means", order = c("yes", "no"))

null_dist <- yrbss %>%
  drop_na(physical_3plus) %>%
  specify(weight ~ physical_3plus) %>%
  hypothesize(null = "independence") %>%
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "permute") %>%
  calculate(stat = "diff in means", order = c("yes", "no"))

print(obs_diff)
print(null_dist)
```

## Exercise 6 

```{r}
#| title: get-null

null_dist %>%
  filter(stat >= obs_diff$stat) %>%
  summarise(n_at_least_obs = n())

```

Based on the above, none of our null permutations has a difference of at least obs_stat

```{r}
#| title: null-dist 

null_dist %>%
  get_p_value(obs_stat = obs_diff, direction = "two_sided")

```

## Exercise 7 

```{r}
#| title: boot-dist

boot_dist <- yrbss %>%
  drop_na(physical_3plus, weight) %>%
  specify(weight ~ physical_3plus) %>%
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "bootstrap") %>%
  calculate(stat = "diff in means", order = c("yes", "no"))

ci <- boot_dist %>%
  get_confidence_interval(level = 0.95, type = "percentile")

ci

```

## Exercise 8 

```{r}
#| title: boot-height

boot_height <- yrbss %>%
  drop_na(height) %>%
  specify(response = height) %>%
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "bootstrap") %>%
  calculate(stat = "mean")

ci_height <- boot_height %>%
  get_confidence_interval(level = 0.95, type = "percentile")

ci_height

```

## Exercise 9

```{r}
#| title: 90-conf

ci_height_90 <- boot_height %>%
  get_confidence_interval(level = 0.90, type = "percentile")

ci_height_90

```

The confidence interval seemed to not move.

## Exercise 10 

```{r}
#| title: heigh-hyp-test

obs_diff_height <- yrbss %>%
  drop_na(physical_3plus, height) %>%
  specify(height ~ physical_3plus) %>%
  calculate(stat = "diff in means", order = c("yes", "no"))

null_dist_height <- yrbss %>%
  drop_na(physical_3plus, height) %>%
  specify(height ~ physical_3plus) %>%
  hypothesize(null = "independence") %>%
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "permute") %>%
  calculate(stat = "diff in means", order = c("yes", "no"))

null_dist_height %>%
  get_p_value(obs_stat = obs_diff_height, direction = "two-sided")

visualize(null_dist_height) +
  shade_p_value(obs_stat = obs_diff_height, direction = "two-sided")
```

There seems to be no difference at all when comparing height and activity level.

## Exercise 12

We could ask the question "Is there a difference in mean weight between those who get fewer than 7 hours of sleep on school night and those who get more than 8 hours?" we can use $\alpha$ = .05

```{r}
#| title: sleep

yrbss <- yrbss %>%
  mutate(sleep_group = case_when(
    school_night_hours_sleep %in% c("<5", "5", "6") ~ "under7",
    school_night_hours_sleep %in% c("7", "8", "9", "10+") ~ "7plus",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

sleep_data <- yrbss %>% drop_na(sleep_group, weight)

sleep_data %>%
  group_by(sleep_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_weight = mean(weight), sd_weight = sd(weight))

obs_diff_sleep <- sleep_data %>%
  specify(weight ~ sleep_group) %>%
  calculate(stat = "diff in means", order = c("under7", "7plus"))

null_dist_sleep <- sleep_data %>%
  specify(weight ~ sleep_group) %>%
  hypothesize(null = "independence") %>%
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "permute") %>%
  calculate(stat = "diff in means", order = c("under7", "7plus"))

null_dist_sleep %>%
  get_p_value(obs_stat = obs_diff_sleep, direction = "two-sided")

visualize(null_dist_sleep) +
  shade_p_value(obs_stat = obs_diff_sleep, direction = "two-sided")

obs_diff_sleep <- sleep_data %>%
  specify(weight ~ sleep_group) %>%
  calculate(stat = "diff in means", order = c("under7", "7plus"))

null_dist_sleep <- sleep_data %>%
  specify(weight ~ sleep_group) %>%
  hypothesize(null = "independence") %>%
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "permute") %>%
  calculate(stat = "diff in means", order = c("under7", "7plus"))

null_dist_sleep %>%
  get_p_value(obs_stat = obs_diff_sleep, direction = "two-sided")

boot_sleep <- sleep_data %>%
  specify(weight ~ sleep_group) %>%
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "bootstrap") %>%
  calculate(stat = "diff in means", order = c("under7", "7plus"))

get_confidence_interval(boot_sleep, level = 0.95, type = "percentile")
```

With a ci as wide as this, we can confidently say that the students who sleep less weigh .748 and 2.0 kg more on average than those who regularly sleep more than 7 hours on school nights.
